content.comment_body: New [product_name] Series [version_no]
This sounds promising. I'm eager to see it arrive on the market.
Exciting news! Looking forward to it.
Is there any updated information on this new [product_name] since its initial press release in March, such as details on release date or specifications?
No new updates regarding specifications. There's no official release date, but it might come out in October 2020. Not guaranteed, though.

The anticipation is making things tricky. I have several new projects that could use [version_no], but having a direct data link to AWS would simplify things. The current information isn’t enough for me to decide whether to wait for this new release. If there was at least documentation or a release date, it would be easier to plan. I expect the hardware changes will be significant and that most new communication features won't be available for the present generation.

Has it launched yet? Viewing [url], it seems to be released. However, the latest software update is [product_name] [version_no], and checking the product page at [url], there’s no information about cloud integration. The ecosystem and versioning remain quite confusing.
I’ve also been trying to determine its release status. I'd order it immediately if it's available.

Hello, In [document], there’s no info on [product_name] [version_no], no product announcement, and no software update. But I’ve heard it will be released soon; delivery is planned by the end of October 2020. At that time, [product_name] [version_no], [product_name] V[version_no], and [product_name] V[version_no] should all be available.
This could be a major advancement for [product_name]. The new [product_name] Web Editor also works well with older models like [version_no].
The order numbers for the new [product_name] [version_no] are activated in the shop. Delivery dates haven't been set yet. Example: [article_no]
There is a link to the manual for the new [product_name] [version_no] in Product Support: [document] [article_no] Edition 10/2020.
You can find a link to the Operating Instructions for the new Web Editor V[version_no] in Product Support: [document] Online Help Edition 10/2020.
Are you certain this is the current manual? It still lists older order numbers and [version_no] as the software (see screenshot from the manual).
Yes, I'm sure.
Did you mean the new Web Editor will also work with [version_no]?
Sometimes it feels pointless to post links to manuals and guides since they're not always reviewed. Attached is an excerpt from the online help for the new Web Editor.
Interestingly, I get the old version ([version_no]) when downloading the PDF, but online I see the new version ([version_no]). Could this be a caching problem?

I don't think it's a cache problem; perhaps [company_name] has an issue with their language sites. In Germany, I can download the English manual edition 10/2020, but the German version is still from 03/2019. Even after clearing my browser cache several times, the problem persists. The same applies to the web editor online help; the English is new, while the German is outdated.
This happened previously in 2017 during the release of manuals for [version_no] and Web Editor help. It took several days to access the correct files back then.

It seems the major new feature is the IoT cloud integration, which is limited to AWS and not open to custom MQTT servers. Also, the cloud feature cannot operate at the same time as the internal web server. Anyone notice additional features?
As far as I know, only AWS is supported for now. Perhaps in [version_no] or a future update, support for other cloud services will be added.

Also, the product is only available via Amazon Prime, with longer delivery times, which puts pressure on resellers. It’s a frustrating situation. But being dependent on Google or Microsoft isn’t great either.
Here you can download [product_name] [version_no]. Unfortunately, the PDF isn’t available yet.
Hello [user_name], it's good to see you participating in both forums. Please remember to post in German on the German forum and in English on the international one for consistency.

Hi everyone, I checked internally about the difference in documentation updates. The content for various languages will be released gradually, not due to technical issues or the 'user.' Please be patient, the documents should be available soon. Best regards, [user_name]

It’s unusual that the cloud feature is restricted to Amazon AWS. Since the new [product_name] uses standard MQTT, [company_name] could potentially make the MQTT server configurable, allowing users flexibility with local or remote servers.
Hello. Does anyone know when the [product_name] [version_no] update will be downloadable?
Yes, [company_name] has that information, but forum users do not.
How do you know that [company_name] could easily make the MQTT server configurable? Are you involved in development?

[company_name] could potentially do this, but according to the [version_no] documentation, it isn’t currently an option. Maybe it’ll come in a firmware update. Communication uses mutual TLS authentication (mTLS), with AWS providing certificates based on CSRs from [product_name]. So it’s not just a matter of an address; there’s integrated PKI in [version_no]. By the way, I received confirmation this morning from [company_name] via a wholesale partner that [version_no] will be available for delivery this month. So, next week we'll know.
The new version is available for purchase in Czechia for under 110 EUR (excluding VAT). There’s a link for upgrading [product_name], but only [version_no] is currently offered.
Hello, Here you can download the new [product_name] software: [url]
Good find! I will test it soon.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum participants are highly anticipating the launch of [product_name] [version_no], drawn by its enhanced cloud integration and new communication capabilities. Their enthusiasm is tempered by a lack of clear details about release dates, compatibility, and feature lists, leading to confusion and hesitation to move forward with purchases or new projects. Problems with documentation, inconsistent naming and versioning, and poorly coordinated updates between hardware and software are resulting in a fragmented user experience.
analysis.user_expectations: Users seek transparent and timely communication about product specifications, release schedules, and new features for each version. They prefer coordinated releases of hardware, software, and documentation so they can make informed decisions on purchasing and designs.
